macro_summary: The July jobs report delivered a significant shock: the U.S. economy shed 23,000 nonfarm payroll jobs versus an 83,000-95,000 consensus, and prior months were revised down by a combined 103,000. This has sharply repriced Fed rate-hike expectations, with FedWatch now at 58.1% odds for no September hike versus a prior-priced hike. Gold broke above $4,300 and silver surged ~11% on the week as Treasury yields and the dollar fell. Equity futures are modestly positive as rate-sensitive tech digests a softer macro picture and eyes turn to NVDA's August 26 earnings as the next major market-moving event.

ideas.name: NVIDIA Corporation
ideas.thesis: NVDA has a confirmed earnings event on August 26 with consensus revenue guidance of ~$91-94B, against a backdrop of a just-announced exclusive SpaceX Starmind chip deal and Counterpoint Research data showing NVDA powers 92% of sovereign AI LLM deployments globally. The stock is trading at ~$224 while 69 analysts carry an average 12-month price target near $303-$317 — a ~35-40% gap. With the weaker jobs print reducing September rate-hike risk, tech multiples face less compression headwind into the print.
ideas.catalyst: Q2 FY2027 earnings confirmed Wednesday August 26, 2026, after market close; consensus revenue ~$91-94B, with Blackwell ramp and AI customer financing commentary as key watch items.
ideas.edge: 69 analyst consensus price target ~$302-$317 vs. $223.96 Polygon prev close = ~35-41% implied upside. 36 of 37 covering analysts rate it Buy/Strong Buy; revenue estimates revised upward 6.81% in the past 3 months. Options-preferred: defined-risk call spreads or long calls into the Aug 26 print allow participation without full stock-price risk.
ideas.bull_case: SpaceX exclusive deal + sovereign AI dominance (92% market share) + $91B Q2 revenue guidance gives a clear beat-and-raise setup; if Blackwell shipments are strong, the stock could close much of the ~$80 gap to consensus targets in a single session.
ideas.bear_case: NVDA missed EPS consensus last quarter ($1.752 vs $1.866 expected); AI infrastructure spending concerns resurfaced after SpaceX earnings rattled investors, and the stock is already up ~11% YTD from lows. Any guidance softness or AI capex slowdown commentary could trigger a sharp post-earnings reversal.

ideas.name: Hims & Hers Health, Inc.
ideas.thesis: HIMS reports Q2 2026 earnings Monday August 10 after close — a binary event with high uncertainty. However, GLP-1/peptide revenue ramp is the key variable; if semaglutide subscription revenue accelerates materially, the stock could gap up significantly. Options are the preferred vehicle given the wide range of outcomes.

ideas.bear_case: Another large EPS miss (as in Q1) combined with BofA's view of structural 2026 revenue risk and subscriber retention concerns could push the stock toward the $25 bear-case target; insiders have collectively sold $106M more than bought in the past 12 months.

ideas.name: VanEck Gold Miners ETF
ideas.thesis: Friday's -23,000 jobs print collapsed Fed rate-hike bets for September, drove gold to $4,315+ and silver to a 6-week high at ~$64 (+11% weekly), and knocked the dollar to a 2-week low. GDX is ~29% below its March 2026 all-time high of ~$117 despite gold trading near record levels, creating an operating leverage setup where miners' margins are expanding while the equity discount has widened. ideas.bull_case: If the Fed signals a rate hold at the September meeting and gold holds above $4,300, gold miner operating margins continue expanding and the equity discount to spot gold narrows, potentially closing a significant portion of the gap to March highs.
ideas.bear_case: GDX is an ETF of companies, not direct gold exposure — any rebound in the dollar or reversal of rate-cut bets (e.g., a hot CPI print) could quickly reverse the precious metals rally. The ETF is already down 3% YTD and technical signals are mixed.
